title: Treatment of Offences by Vape Users who Have Participated in I Quit Programme
what_it_is: Treatment of Offences by Vape Users who Have Participated in I Quit Programme

sections.label: I Quit vape participants
sections.summary: I Quit participants are not immune from prosecution for illegal vaping possession or use, and 112,000 joined since May 2014.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health for vape users who participate in the I Quit programme (a) whether these participants have been offered immunity from criminal prosecution; (b) how many have benefited from this programme to date; and (c) what happens if the users are subsequently caught using vapes again.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: So, participants need not worry that they will be fined or prosecuted, just for joining the I Quit programme or for turning up for the sessions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: That said, I Quit participants are not immune from criminal prosecution with regard to the illegal possession or use of vaping products.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: If caught, they are subject to the same enforcement actions as other offenders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: A total of 112,000 participants have joined the I Quit programme since May 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The number is correct as of December 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The programme does not keep track of which participants are smokers or vapers.
